import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def task_func(l):
    l = np.array(list(l), dtype=float)
    fig, ax = plt.subplots()

    if l.size == 0:
        ax.set_title("Fit results: mu = nan,  std = nan")
        return ax

    mu, std = stats.norm.fit(l)

    ax.hist(l, bins="auto", density=True, alpha=0.7)

    if std > 0:
        xmin, xmax = ax.get_xlim()
        x = np.linspace(xmin, xmax, 100)
        p = stats.norm.pdf(x, mu, std)
        ax.plot(x, p, linewidth=2)
    else:
        ax.axvline(mu, linewidth=2)

    ax.set_title(f"Fit results: mu = {mu:.2f},  std = {std:.2f}")

    return ax
